last_session.detail: They arrived at sunset. The party assumes the treasure lies at one of the marked locations, but all the surrounding land is unknown to them.
last_session.text: The party arrived in Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked places they did not recognize.

last_session.detail: Reginald said the Clurichen is up to no good and that wherever it goes they should stay away.
last_session.text: Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that a trickster Clurichen comes into town from the riverbanks each night.

last_session.detail: Dunk preferred solitude to the inns and split from the party to scavenge at the farm. Gill's legend: Sir Brandon got a magic sword from a fairy in the woods, and he and his friends killed a dragon that had terrorized the town for weeks. The town was named after him, and they were knighted, then left; Brandon died. That dragon was dragged through town and ripped apart hundreds of years ago. Gill assumes the current dragon is a different one and does not know where dragons come from. Gill saw the current dragon, which wanted nothing to do with him, and sent his three sons after it. Dunk asked to sleep in the barn and think over an offer; they drank from Gill's still while Gill shared gossip.
last_session.text: Dunk drank with Farmer Gill, who told him the legend of Sir Brandon and the town's first dragon.

last_session.detail: Eric wants the dragon killed and its body dragged into town, calling it the first of many problems. He said the woodsman George lost an arm to the dragon, which George described as a small black dragon. When Eric defended George's account, Sir Phidipaldi slapped him with his glove and challenged him to a duel at dawn. The flustered Eric did not accept, saying only that Sir Phidipaldi was more skilled at adventure.
last_session.text: Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold for the dragon, and Sir Phidipaldi challenged him to a duel.

last_session.detail: Uriah brought him a Fox Tail Brew; Ned recognized Uriah as a Dagonite. Uriah said he was a scholar of folk remedies and lore looking for work with his crew. Ned asked 100 gold for the week. Asked about a night of at least ten kills, Ned kept the fee but offered back 5 gold per kill if he could do what he wanted with the victims.
last_session.text: Drop Dead Ned, a thief with a killer wasp, offered to hire on with Dr. Uriah, who said he would think about it.

last_session.detail: Quinn says his good stock is gone each morning with half the glasses empty or knocked over, so he waters down what he has. He believes Bentley steals it because Bentley's Fox Tail Brew is so popular. Quinn offered 100 gold and proposed a fake shipment.
last_session.text: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn, the Golden Egg's keeper, catch whoever empties his ale each night.

open.text: Find the treasure shown on the party's map.

open.detail: The party never explicitly accepted Eric's offer; Sir Phidipaldi said they would talk to the Reeve, then denied the dragon exists and challenged Eric to a duel.
open.text: Kill the black dragon and drag its body into town to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.

open.detail: The ale goes missing from the Golden Egg.
open.text: Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale each night and collect Quinn's 100 gold.

open.detail: Lady Hilda is a seasoned fighter in chain mail with a shield. She won't hunt the dragon alone.
open.text: If the party pays Lady Hilda, she will join them to hunt the dragon.

open.detail: Dr. Uriah said he would think about it. For a night of many kills, Ned offered back 5 gold per kill if he could do what he wanted with the victims.
open.text: If Dr. Uriah pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold a week, Ned and his killer wasp will do anything. Ned insists on killing people.

open.detail: Quinn brings bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to the Golden Egg.
open.text: If Sir Phidipaldi stages the fake ale delivery, the party may see who comes for Quinn's ale.

open.detail: The party assumes the treasure lies at one of the marked locations.
open.text: Where are the places marked on the party's treasure map?

open.detail: Half the glasses are left empty or knocked over. Quinn believes Bentley is stealing it.
open.text: Who or what empties Quinn's good ale each night?
Where does the black dragon lurk outside Brandonsford?

open.detail: Bentley's restocking shipment is a week overdue.
open.text: What happened to Bentley's overdue shipment, and why has nothing arrived in months?

open.detail: Sir Brandon's dragon was killed centuries ago and none has appeared since.
open.text: Where did this new dragon come from?

open.detail: Gill sent his three sons after the dragon and says they are trying to kill it now.
open.text: The black dragon tore off the woodsman George's arm, and Gill's three sons are hunting it now.
